reachability_signal: Script exercises the old and new _encodeFilenameFlags implementations directly with test inputs matching both branches (flag_bits with/without UTF-8 flag, ASCII/non-ASCII filenames). All code paths in the target function are covered.
expected_signal: cp437-encodable filenames without UTF-8 flag produce different bytes and flags in old vs new implementations, confirming the OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGE.
input_strategy: Test with cp437-encodable non-ASCII names (fünf, café, résumé, München, São Paulo) and unicode-only names (你好, 日本語, 한국어) with flag_bits=0 and flag_bits=_MASK_UTF_FILENAME. Also test ASCII names for flag bit clearing behavior.
limitations: Pure Python test harness - does not test the full ZipFile append flow with actual ZIP file I/O. Only directly tests the _encodeFilenameFlags encoding logic.
